eval.description: ByteDance Seed internal multimodal biology benchmark. It asks models to reason from experimental figures and related biology text, as shown in the Seed1.8 model card. Cards report Pass@1 or accuracy as a percent. Samples are not public.
eval.summary: Measures how well the model reasons about biology from experimental figures and related text.

versions.changes: Seed1.8 calls it internal BIOBench; Seed2.0 tables report BIObench. No public samples or fixed rubric.

scores.description: 1 when the model answer matches the internal label for the item.

metrics.description: Pass@1 accuracy as reported in Seed cards (often shown as a percent).
